book.name: 2 Akakolintu
book.title: Baluwa jhubhele jha Pauli kwa Akakolintu

content: Pauli na akatenga bhuwange
Nipala nhimbalile kandina, pamonga nibhonekana nalindindilima. Nhwimbalile kachoko!
Nimone wiho, ngita Chapanga pamonela wiho, nhwalo mangota mmii ngita nchikana jwangakongana na munalome jwalepwe inyaghabhule kwa munalome jhumo tugha jwenio ndi Kilichitu.
Nambo nijhoghopa kubhehe malango ghino ghahotola kughalambulwa na mangota chimuleka kuhobholelwa kwino kwa Kilichitu ngita Hawa chakolwiwa na uwange gwa lijhoka.

Nhwalo mundo jhojhoha anda ahika kwino na kuntangacha Yecho jwangalandana na jhola tuntangacha twenga, mangota mupokela kwa mabhoko mabhele. Na mangota anda mkapokii Uhuke jhonge jwangalandana na hela jha Uhuke gwa Chapanga, na anda mukalipokile Lilobhe lya Chapanga lyangalandana na lela lituntangachila twenga mughahimbilile mambu agha kwa ujhojhoho!
Nihambuka jhe kubhehe nenga ndi jwandina kuliku bhene bhubhakikema, akatenga akakolongwa.
Pange nibhonekana nilonge jhe mbone, nambo ngwete uhotolo gwa kumanya ilebhe ya mahele, lijhambu lende litendike limanyikana kwino kila chehemo na kipinde choha.
Bho, ndehi uhakaho kwa kukihuluwa namwene na kunhobhowa mangota kwa kwatangachii jhajhe Lilobhe lya Mbone lya Chapanga?
Punikibha ninhengela mangota, ilebhe yoha ibhokite kwa lilongo lya bhando bhange bhubhanyeketii Kilichitu. Ndehila ngita kupoka bhange ilebhe yabhe mbate kunhengela mangota.

Punikibha na mangota nikantotwii jhe mundo jhojhoha pumbata kilebhe, nhwalo akalongo bhubhabhokite ku Makedoniya bhakambekii kila ilebhe imbalita. Nikapahi jhe kumponja kilebhe chochoha chela na nijhendelila kuhenga yenio.
Kwa uchakaka Kilichitu abhii nkate jhango, abhii jhe mundo jhojhoha jwabhii ku kilambo cha ku Akaya jwahoto kunhibhilila nenga kukiloka kwango.
Bho, punilonge naha mihambuka nimpala jhe? Chapanga amanya kubhehe nenga nimpala!

Nijhendelela kuhenga chela chinihenga ngohe, kupala kwahibhilila ndela bhala bhubhakikema akatenga akakolongwa, bhala bhubhapala kukiloka, ngita bhala bhubhakiloka bhahenga lihengo ngita lituhenga twenga.
Nhwalo bhando bheniya ndi akatenga bhuwange, bhahenga lihengo lyabhe kwa uwange bhubhakikopokeya akatenga bha Kilichitu.
Nkoto kukangacha, nhwalo Limbembela lihotola kukikopokeya kubhonekana ntumiche jwa kunane kwa Chapanga jwa lumule!
Yene tukangacha jhe anda akahenga lihengo bha Limbembela bhakikopokeya bhabhonekane akatumiche bhaumbone, nambo kujhomolela kwabhe nabhapokela chikipalwa.
Pauli ang'ahichwa ngita ntenga
Nenga nilonge kabhele, mundo jhojhoha akoto kummona nenga nalindindilima. Anda umwene nenga nalindindima, umbokela yenio anda nenga nalindindima mbate kuloka pandina.
Chinikilongela ngohe chi chela chalaghalikiye Bhambo nongele, nambo nhwalo gwa kukiloka, nenga nilongii ngita mundo nalindindima.
Nhwalo bhando bhamahele bhakiloka anda bhando bha pannema chibhaloka, nenga helahela nikiloka.
Mangota mabhene bhumii na malango hake, ndi nhwalo mahimbilila mandindilima kwa kuhangana!
Mangota munhimbalila mundo jwantenda makabhanda, mwahimbilila bhando bhubhapala ilebhe twe kuliku chibhapalwa kupata, jwakikweya na bhubhanimbilikiya na kumpucha, bhamata mbalamande kumiho.
Nikola hone kujheketela gheniya kwa twenga tukahotwiijhe kujheketela. Nambo nilonge anda mundo nalindindima, anda abhii mundo jhojhoha jwapala kukilokela kilebhe, na nenga nijhigha kukiloka.

Bho, bheniya ndi Akaebulaniya? Nenga helahela ndi Mwebulaniya. Bho, bheniya Akaichilahele? Nenga helahela Mwichilahele. Bho bheniya bhahumii mulukolo lwa Ulahimo? Nenga helahela nihumii mu lukolo lwa Ulahimo.

Bho, bheniya ndi akatumiche bha Kilichitu? Nilonge ngita nde kupombwa, nenga ndi natumiche jwa Kilichitu kupeta bheniya! Nenga hengite lihengo lyamahele kupeta bheniya, mbungitwe mukipungo kupeta bheniya, nikatyalitwe kwa limbendela lya ndomondo kupeta bheniya, nikibha mukuhandahanda jha ngondo jha kuwegha kupeta bheniya.
Nikatyalitwe mala nhwano na limbendela lya ndomondo yato makome matato na ticha na Akayahude.
Nikatyalitwe na limbendela lya ndomondo patato na Akaloma, nikakong'winde na maghanga mala jhimo, nikatenywikilwe na mele mulilabha mala patato, na mala jhimo nikapipiki totolo mumbwane muhe na kilo.

Mumwanja gwango nikibha mukuhandahanda jha ngondo jha kukokolwa na mache, nikibha mukuhandahanda jha ngondo jha kubulwa na akawiye, nikibha mukuhandahanda jha ngondo jha Akayahude ajhango na bhangabhehe Akayahude, nikibha mukuhandahanda jha ngondo pa bomane, nikibha mukuhandahanda jha ngondo kumanyahe, nikibha mukuhandahanda jha ngondo mumbwane, nikibha mukuhandahanda jha ngondo kwa akalongo bhuwange.
Nikahengite lihengo linonoho na kulagha, nikagholwike jhe, nikibha na njala na nyota, nikibha jhe na chukulyegha, nikapemite malile na nikibha jhe na ngobho.
Pamonga na gheniya ghoha, kila lichiko natangatila kwahengela makunde gha bhando bhubhanyeketii Kilichitu.
Anda abhii mundo jwaleghelike, na nenga helahela nibhehe leghele. Anda mundo jhonge antenda agweghe mu uhakaho, nenga helahela nibhona lipyanda hake.
Anda imbala kukiloka, nikilokela ghala ghighalangiya nenga neghelike.
Chapanga, Tate jwa Bhambo Yecho, ndi alumbalilwe machiko ghoha ghangapeta, jwenio amanya kubhehe chinilongela nilonge jhe uwange.
Punikibha ku Damasiko, nkolo jwa bomane, jwalongochwa na munahota nkolongwa Aleta, akabhekite akalonda pa bomane bhapata bhangamule.
Nambo nikabhekitwe mu kitandabhala, nyakuhuwa pa lidilicha lya lipamanda, nyakupokonyoka mu mabhoko ghake.
